verdict.rationale: Termius documents one native event-triggered action: a startup snippet that runs each time you connect to a host. Environment variables are also sent automatically on connect. This is a single fixed trigger (connect) with a fixed action type, not a general rule engine for defining event-to-action automations. missing for 10: user-definable rules across multiple event types (e.g., disconnect, output match, schedule), conditional logic, AI-driven or programmable triggers, independent corroboration of the startup-snippet behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
